complete_queue_rule: y3 non-null and duration through landmarks >= 72 h

cohort.definition: y3 is non-null and observed duration is at least 72 hours
cohort.conditioning: Stays observable through 72 hours; estimates do not generalize to stays discharged or dying before 72 hours.

features.rule: First-24-hour static/demographic/laboratory features plus non-overlapping 24-hour summary windows available through the landmark; no later window is used at an earlier landmark.

xgb_model.fold_scope: one patient-grouped 5-fold partition shared by all landmarks

dg_gru_model.prediction: mean of the three seed probabilities
dg_gru_model.fold_scope: patient-grouped 5-fold partition generated once on the same complete queue

dg_comparison.comparability_warning: Predictions are paired on the same patients, outcomes, and shared fold partition, but XGBoost is a single-seed model and DG-GRU is a three-seed probability ensemble. Differences combine algorithm, feature representation, and seed-averaging effects.

uncertainty.method: cluster bootstrap of the evaluation sample
uncertainty.scope: Conditional on the fitted out-of-fold predictions and fixed fold partition; training and fold-selection uncertainty are not resampled.
